key_terms: A Pinot table that ingests records from a stream such as Kafka instead of from uploaded batch segments.
An in-progress real-time segment that a server builds from stream records and later commits as a completed segment.
The row count or time limit at which a consuming segment is completed and committed.
The configured component, here JSON, that turns stream messages into typed column values.
The gap between the latest source offset and the records already queryable in Pinot. A small query result does not show it is zero.
evidence: Prepared actual Pinot Docker workshop and explicitly scoped extensions. Qualification ledger distinguishes source, native service acceptance, indexes, streaming, hybrid/upsert and multistage observations.
